road.backdrop.far.brief: Far wooded hills along the river valley, two low ridges, the farther one paler, their tops broken by tree crowns. Few tones and little detail: these are miles off. Tiles left to right; transparent above the hill line.

road.backdrop.highbank_far.brief: Highbank seen from miles down the river: a flat-topped bluff with a row of roofs on it, and the Wayline Tower about 70 px tall on the bluff, painted for this size, not shrunk from the big one. Read it as a hooked column with one lit dot: a living root climbs the left side and curls over the top in a crook 2 to 3 px thick, and a small amber lamp (2 x 3 px) hangs under the hook (the beacon anchor is the lamp's middle). Below the crook, top to bottom: a 3 px ring bar with lantern specks (one gap), a short tick for the bell on the left, the round tiers stepping out, a 2 px hoist tick with its rope on the right, the depot with its dark door, a root slope on the left and a yard nub on the right. Every stroke 2 px or more; one or two broken 1 px cables from the ring down to the roofs are a bonus, never the read (wayline_top to wayline_end is one of them). Paint in full colour, unhazed: the scene hazes it. The bluff runs off the bottom edge. The tower's design is docs/design/wayline-tower-2026-10-27/TOWER_DESIGN.md (mock_far_view.png shows this slot at 4x).
road.backdrop.highbank_far.notes: drawn at 0.82x growing to 1x as the party nears the rise, hazed by the scene (0.5 down to 0.3); the game draws the Waiting Lamp unhazed on anchors.beacon (it breathes) and a slow glint of light running down the cable from anchors.wayline_top to anchors.wayline_end; the placeholder's tower is TowerParts.paint_far(70); cx-10 re-brief, after the tower's crown is approved

road.backdrop.mid.brief: The wooded river trail: weeping willows with long hanging strands, their trunks down to the trail, flood debris caught in them (a snapped branch in a fork, driftwood at a root, a tangle of reeds). Gaps between the trees show the river and hills behind. Tiles left to right.
road.backdrop.mid.notes: parallax 0.45, hazed 0.1; fades out near the rise (the trees open)

road.backdrop.near.brief: Near foliage in front of the trail: dark ferns and reeds with seed heads, close to the camera, darkest of all the layers. Nothing above row 12. Tiles left to right; transparent above the plants.
road.backdrop.near.notes: parallax 1.35, drawn in front of the party

road.backdrop.river.brief: The river glimpsed between the willows: a band of slow brown-green water still high from the flood, pale streaks of current and a few glints of morning sky, a thin dark far bank along its top. Tiles left to right.
road.backdrop.river.notes: parallax 0.3; the scene lowers it 18 px and fades it out over the first half of the trail (the river dropping back)

road.backdrop.sky.brief: The dawn sky over the river valley the morning after the storm: cool slate blue at the top, warming through pale grey and rose to gold at the horizon (row 140), a few torn cloud bands lit gold underneath. Sky only, no ground, no sun disc. It does not scroll.
road.backdrop.sky.notes: parallax 0; everything below row 150 is covered by the trail

road.backdrop.vista.brief: The rise at first light: the willows open on both sides and Highbank lies below on its bluff, rows of roofs and chimneys, and over all of it the Wayline Tower, about 176 px tall with its foot near x 268. It is the approved tower (docs/design/wayline-tower-2026-10-27/TOWER_DESIGN.md), painted for this size: a living root climbs its left side and curls over the top in a crook, the Waiting Lamp hangs lit under the hook (the beacon anchor is the lamp's middle), then the ring deck with its lanterns (one dark), the bell on the left, the round tiers stepping out, the hoist on the right, the depot with its arched door, the root's foot on the left and the yard on the right. Two cables run from the ring down to the roofs, a small cradle on each. Grassy ground in the near left where the two stand (the party anchor is the leader's feet). Street lamps at the lamp anchors (paint them unlit: the game lights them and puts them out one by one) and chimney tops at the chimney anchors (the game draws the smoke). No house hides the tower's door.
road.backdrop.vista.notes: held view at the rise; coded effects: the house lamps going out one by one while the Waiting Lamp stays lit and breathes, chimney smoke; the placeholder's tower is TowerParts.small(176), the whole tower shrunk (paint_far turned to flat blocks at this size); cx-10 re-brief, after the tower's crown is approved

road.ground.path.brief: The trail seen from the side: a grass verge at the back, a band of churned mud (rows 4 to 21) with cart ruts and rain puddles holding the sky, then a grassy slope down to the bottom. The party's feet stand on row 10. Tiles left to right.
road.ground.path.notes: parallax 1 (moves with the party and the props)

road.prop.ferry_sign.brief: A washed-out ferry sign by the trail: a leaning post with a plank sign, a boat painted on it (a picture, no letters), a flood line staining its lower half and a corner broken off. Mud at the foot.
road.prop.ferry_sign.notes: on the trail at x 430 (the bluff beat: the roads wash out every spring)

road.prop.lost_parcel.brief: A lost parcel half sunk in the mud at the trail's edge: a paper-wrapped box tipped on its corner, its twine dark with river water, the bottom third under mud with a wet sheen.
road.prop.lost_parcel.notes: on the trail at x 2016 (the parcel beat, a camera hold)

road.prop.waymark.brief: A Wayline waymark post: a squared timber post with a brass cap, a carved arrow pointing up the trail (right), a teal courier band, and an arm holding an unlit trail lantern.
road.prop.waymark.notes: on the trail at x 1236 (the Tower beat)

story.backdrop.tower_sky.brief: A banded dawn sky over Highbank: flat bands from a deep dawn blue at the top through slate and grey-blue to a warm rose and gold strip along the bottom, two or three long thin clouds low on the left and right, and the top two thirds left empty. The Waiting Lamp hangs about 127 px down the screen at the middle when the camera stops at the tower's top, so keep the sky behind it a calm cool blue the amber stands out against. Sky only, no tower painted in: the tower is drawn over it. It does not scroll.

title.backdrop.highbank.brief: Highbank seen from across the river at the golden hour, the old title village's time of day and mood. The Wayline Tower is the hero: about 162 px tall on Tower Rise at the right (frame x 284 to 380, vane tip near y 6, foot on row 167), the Waiting Lamp lit under the crook at (333, 33). Below it, small and in street order from the west: Home, the Item Shop, Storage and the Scroll Keeper along the bluff, the Crossroads and the Rise stair under the tower's door, waylines from the deck down to posts on their roofs (one slack under the dark lantern), the bluff face with the switchbacks and the ferry dock, and the river in front. Keep the sky calm behind the wordmark (x 90 to 295, y 0 to 52) and keep the crook and lamp right of x 312, where the title's canopy shade stops, and paint the sky right of x 312 above row 50 one band darker so it meets the shaded sky with no edge; the lower left (x 0 to 140, y 100 down) sits under the menu and its dark wash, so keep it quiet. No text.
title.backdrop.highbank.notes: Placeholder: the game's own tower blockout and house slot pictures shrunk to 0.225 and snapped to the tower palette, placed from the Street's area data; sky, hills, bluff and river painted in code (47 colours, PALETTE in the painter). The tower names are working labels.

town.building.hall.brief: The Wayline Tower's depot, the door part (read TOWER_DESIGN.md and the key, town.building.hall.key, first): the wide ground storey the tower stands on. Its roof deck seen from above (mostly under the drum) with a skylight, crates, an oilcloth stack and the mess chimney; a parapet lip; a limestone and loess-brick front on a boulder footing; the runners' porch on the left under a moss awning (satchel hooks, one empty, a bench, a round window); the First Post, an old relay stone worn pale by partners' hands, in the left jamb; the grand arch with its three-route fan-light and the 48 x 64 double door; and on the right the loading bay under its canopy, a chute bin, a burrow hatch and high-water cuts. Lit from the upper left, wayline_tower palette, no outer outline.
town.building.hall.notes: 2026-10-27 approved tower (Reach and Waiting Lamp, defaults): this row is now the 300 x 192 depot at frame (66, 528) of the 432 x 720 tower; the other parts are scripts/art/slots/town_tower.gd. The 300 x 576 single-picture tower and Codex's cx-01 hall candidate (and the old 240 x 144 Hall) are superseded. beacon and apex are in the depot's px, above its top (negative y), so the reveal finds the lamp. Base 12x3 and doors kept; door 48 wide so Galeshear (63 px wide) passes C11; open frames come from door_px; legacy_v1 is still the v1 picture.

town.building.hall.key.brief: The whole Wayline Tower at half size (432 x 720 shown as 216 x 360): the style key every part is painted to. A rooted river-stone tower built in eras round a living root, the Reach, that climbs the left face and curls over the top to hold the Waiting Lamp on its chain right above the double door. Match the blockout's layout and silhouette exactly; settle materials, light and the shading columns here once.

town.building.hall.lamp.brief: Part of the Wayline Tower: read TOWER_DESIGN.md and the key (town.building.hall.key) first. Paint exactly this cell, lit from the upper left, from the wayline_tower palette only, with no outer outline (the game rims the tower). The Waiting Lamp on its short chain from the Reach's hook: the bail, a vented brass cap, amber panes with a centre bar, and the drip pan. The glass centre is the beacon (frame 216, 118). Lit flickers over 4 frames (the hot pane changes shape); dark is cold glass with one glint. The glow and the sway are coded.

town.building.hall.reach.brief: Part of the Wayline Tower: read TOWER_DESIGN.md and the key (town.building.hall.key) first. The Reach: the living root rising through the deck's moss collar with a gentle S and a flared foot, then curling over to the right like a shepherd's crook to hold the lamp's chain on the door axis (the hook at frame 216, 96). Rootlets binding the loft, three knots, moss on the lit side and along the top of the curl, three worn brass bands, two small leaf tufts and the chain hook.

town.building.hall.ring_front.brief: Part of the Wayline Tower: read TOWER_DESIGN.md and the key (town.building.hall.key) first. ui.frame9.focus_row.brief: The focused row in a list: flat moss inside a brass rim lit on its top and left, with a highlight inside the lit edges and a shade inside the others.

ui.frame9.headshot.brief: The well behind a 48 px headshot: river-blue ground, a shadow inside its top and left, inside a brass rim lit on its top and left.
